stories.story_title: GCI Aleutian subsea fiber break, 6 communities on satellite backup up to 2 weeks
stories.summary: Subsea cable fault near Chignik Bay May 27; cut broadband to Akutan, Chignik Bay, False Pass, King Cove, Perryville, Unalaska. GCI on GEO/LEO satellite backup at degraded capacity. Repair vessel expected ~June 6, full restore 7-14 days out. Third Aleutian cable incident in ~6 months (Dec 2025, Feb 2026, now). Broadband Breakfast ran 'is fiber the right tech for AK' piece.
stories.why: Critical remote communities (Unalaska = top US fishing port) on brittle single-cable architecture; satellite fallback inadequate for telemedicine/fishing logistics.
stories.consequence: Fisheries/healthcare/telecom: GCI churn to Starlink (CEO cited Dec break in 3% YoY cable broadband subscriber decline to 151,200); risk before $310M Quintillion acquisition closes.
stories.NOTE_ORCH: FRESH, un-mined. Strong infra-fragility frame. AI tie INDIRECT (substrate for remote AI/telehealth/LEO-vs-fiber). Lead candidate if AI angle can be earned.

stories.story_title: Trump funding freeze strands $58M DOE Grid Resilience grants to 91 AK tribes
stories.summary: 3+ yrs into IIJA Grid Resilience State & Tribal Formula program, AK tribal entities received <6% of $58M as of early 2026; disbursements halted after Jan 2025 EO on 'unduly burdensome' spending. White Mountain spent ~$400K on generators/cooling expecting reimbursement, lost DOE contact. Kawerak consortium FY25/FY26 tranches unreleased.
stories.why: 200+ AK communities on isolated microgrids; winter generator failure is life-safety. Grid hardening is substrate for remote edge-compute/telehealth AI.
stories.consequence: Rural/tribal energy: Kawerak + 90 entities defer grid hardening through FY26, raising winter failure risk and stranding edge-AI deployments.
stories.NOTE_ORCH: Fresh in-window. AI tie indirect (substrate). Energy-freeze frame partly covered 05-29 prior. Good supporting beat.

stories.story_title: Stak Energy North Slope AI data center DNR comment closes June 15
stories.summary: DNR preliminary best-interest finding May 12 for 50-yr 715-acre lease to Stak Energy, $500M up-to-3GW AI/cloud campus off Dalton Hwy. Self-powered via NS gas pipeline, off Railbelt. Comment period through June 15.
stories.why: First large AI-specific land lease state decision; June 15 is hard gateway.
stories.consequence: O&G/AI real estate: June 15 comment close before final DNR finding; protest risk delays summer-2026 start.
stories.NOTE_ORCH: ALREADY covered (06-02 Anchorage Desk profile of STAK/Mahoney). Repeat. Background only.

stories.story_title: AFCEC AI data center EUL proposals closed May 29 (JBER/Eielson/Clear)
stories.summary: AFCEC RFLP for AI data centers ~4,700 acres across JBER, Eielson, Clear SFS reached May 29 deadline; evaluation phase. No proposals announced by June 5.
